documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: KSH International Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings, highlighting robust volume growth, capacity expansion progress, and strong export performance. Management stated that installed capacity reached 57,845 metric tons after completing 96% of the Phase-1 and Phase-2 Supa expansion ahead of schedule, while announcing a Phase-3 expansion to reach approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 FY29. The company also reported improvements in operating cash flows, working capital days, and a reduction in outstanding debt. KSH International Limited reported its financial and operational results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. Management highlighted robust demand in the power and transformer sectors, alongside capacity expansion efforts including the completion of 96% of its Supa expansion ahead of schedule and a newly approved Phase 3 expansion.

guidance.claim: Management stated that post Phase-3 expansion, a long-term blended EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 should be sustainable.
guidance.quote: Secondly, looking at our overall long-term portfolio and capacity mix and the additional traction with exports and improving operating leverage, we believe post Phase-3 expansion, a long-term EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 85,000 per ton should be sustainable.

guidance.claim: Management expects the company's total installed capacity to increase to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029.
guidance.quote: The board has approved a new Phase-3 expansion to add specialized Magnet Winding Wires manufacturing capacity, and which is expected to increase the company's total installed capacity to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029.

guidance.claim: Management expects the second half of the year to be better than the first half with a 25%-26% volume increase over last year.
guidance.quote: If you take that into account, our second half is expected to be better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees sustained growth and investments across power generation, transmission, and related equipment driven by multiple infrastructure factors.
demand_outlook.quote: We see sustained growth and investments across power generation, transmission and related equipment driven by grid infrastructure development, renewable energy integration, electrification and growth, electricity requirements from industrial and digital infrastructure.

demand_outlook.claim: Specialized Magnet Winding Wires revenue grew at 87% year-over-year during Q2, driven largely by exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Specialized Magnet Winding Wires revenue overall grew at 87% year-over-year during Q2, with much of that growth driven by exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall sales volume was 8,842 metric tons in Q2, up from 7,969 metric tons in Q1 and 7,037 metric tons a year ago.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, sales volume was 8842 metric tons in Q2, was up from 7969 metric tons in Q1 and 7037 metric tons a year ago.

demand_outlook.claim: Export revenue in Q2 grew 108% year-over-year and was 44% higher than last quarter, representing roughly 32% of revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: Export revenue in Q2 grew 108% year-over-year and 44% higher than last quarter. As a result, exports represented almost 32% of our revenue in Q2, up from 26% in Q1.

demand_outlook.claim: The T&D sector is in a structural long-term cycle driven by renewable energy, grid modernization, urbanization, and AI data centers.
demand_outlook.quote: The T&D sector, as you know it, is in a structural long-term cycle driven by renewable energy, grid modernization, urbanization, and growing power demand for AI data centers in India as well as globally.

demand_outlook.claim: Some transformer OEM customers in active capacity expansion mode have delayed picking up their orders by a few weeks.
demand_outlook.quote: There is one short-term industry dynamic we have observed and I feel it's worth calling out, which is that we have seen a few of the transformer OEM customers who are in active capacity expansion mode, delay picking up their orders by a few weeks.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to spend up to Rs. 1,850 million or Rs. 185 crores to finance the Phase-3 expansion, including purchasing 10 acres of land in Supa.
capex_expansion.quote: The company intends to spend up to Rs. 1,850 million or Rs. 185 crores to finance this expansion, which also includes he purchase of an additional 10 acres of land in Supa and it will be funded with a combination of internal accruals and long-term debt.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Phase-3 capacity expansion is expected to be funded by a mix of debt and internal accruals, with expenses incurred primarily in FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: This project will be funded by a mix of debt and internal accruals. We expect the majority of these expenses to be incurred in FY '28 though a smaller upfront portion would likely be spent during H2 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed 96% of its proposed Supa expansion six months ahead of schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Meanwhile, we also completed 96% of our proposed Supa expansion six-months ahead of schedule, giving us 57,845 MT of available capacity heading into the second half of the year.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned capital investment for the strategic expansion of specialized wire capacity at Supa is up to Rs 1,850 Mn.
The upcast backward integration facility in Chakan was commissioned with a capacity of 5,000 metric tons to recycle internal copper scrap.
capex_expansion.quote: Last week, we completed yet another one of our IPO objectives on time by commissioning our upcast backward integration facility in Chakan. This facility will have a capacity of 5,000 metric tons and be used to recycle our own copper scrap, which in turn should provide some modest operating efficiency and further strengthen our sustainability efforts.

capex_expansion.claim: The board authorized management to evaluate acquiring an additional 10 acres of land within Supa MIDC for long-term expansion requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: To secure a long-term capacity, and the second, being to secure a long-term capacity expansion requirements, our board last night authorized management to evaluate acquiring an additional 10 acres of land within Supa MIDC for its long-term expansion requirements.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, EBITDA per ton was approximately Rs. 101,400 per metric ton, up from Rs. 93,000 in Q1 and Rs. 65,500 a year ago.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2 FY '27, we reported EBITDA per ton of approximately Rs. 101,400 per metric ton up from roughly Rs. 93,000 per metric ton in Q1 and Rs. 65,500 per metric ton a year ago.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated utilization rates increased to 76% in Q2 FY27 versus 73% in Q1 FY27 based on available capacity.
margins_costs.quote: The third point being an increase in consolidated utilization rates to 76% in Q2 of FY '27 versus 73% in Q1 of FY '27 based on available capacity for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: During Q2 FY27, the company reported a quarterly record PAT of Rs. 48 crores, representing a 62% increase year-over-year.
margins_costs.quote: During Q2 FY '27, we reported a quarterly record PAT of Rs. 48 crores which increased 62% versus Rs. 30 crores last year and Rs. 42 crores last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Metal prices are fully passed through.
LME copper price and exchange rate are a direct pass-through.
margins_costs.quote: Thus, LME copper price and exchange rate is a direct pass-through.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity as on September 30, 2026, was 57,845 metric tons, which includes 96% of the total capacity expansion planned at Supa.
orders_capacity.quote: Our installed capacity as on September 30th, 2026 was 57,845 metric tons, which includes 96% of the total capacity expansion planned at Supa.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains long-term relations with over 120 leading domestic and global OEM customers with repeat revenue in excess of 95%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are a B2B company servicing over 120 leading domestic and global OEM customers and maintain long term relations with these customers with repeat revenue in excess of 95%.

orders_capacity.claim: Power Grid approved the Supa facility to supply magnet winding wires up to 765 kV transformers and reactors from the newest facility.
orders_capacity.quote: And lastly, 2 weeks ago, Power Grid also approved our Supa facility to supply magnet winding wires up to 765 kV transformers and reactors from our newest facility.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity at June 30th, 2026 stood at 43,445 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our installed capacity at June 30th, 2026 was 43,445 metric tons and once phase two of our Super expansion is complete by the end of this year, this financial year, we would have an installed capacity of roughly 59,000 metric tons, making us the second largest winding wire manufacturer in India.

orders_capacity.claim: Consolidated company utilization improved to about 73.5% in Q1.
orders_capacity.quote: With capacity unchanged, consolidated company utilization improved to about 73.5% in Q1, up from 70% in Q4 of FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: The company entered into a five-year supply framework agreement with Hitachi Energy Global.
orders_capacity.quote: We are very pleased to announce that we have entered into a five-year supply framework agreement with Hitachi Energy Global to supply winding wires to their Indian plants as well as their some of their global plants.

capital_allocation.claim: The company delivered roughly Rs. 43 crores of positive operating cash flow during H1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: As a result of these efforts, we were able to deliver roughly Rs. 43 crores of positive operating cash flow during H1 of FY '27, while also reducing outstanding debt by approximately Rs. 140 crores by September 30th of 2026 from Q1 of FY '27.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days calculated on average balances improved to 52 days from 60 days in Q1 and around 70 days last year.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days calculated on average balances improved to 52 days from 60 days in Q1 and from around 70 days last year.

capital_allocation.claim: The focus on working capital efficiency contributed to positive operating cash flow during H1 FY2027 and a reduction in outstanding debt during the second quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Together with operating growth, our focus on working capital efficiency contributed to positive operating cash flow during H1 FY2027, and a reduction in outstanding debt during the second quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Average working capital days improved to 60 days during the quarter compared to 71 days a year ago.
capital_allocation.quote: After showing a five-day average working capital day improvement in Q4, we were able to improve it by another five days in Q1 during Q1, resulting in an average working capital days of 60 days during the quarter compared to 71 days a year ago.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to return export contribution to its historical average of around 40% of total revenue over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: We said that our objective over the next few years is to return exports to its historical average of around 40% of total revenue. So, that is a multi-year sort of process that we will pursue.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects total installed capacity to increase to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029 following the Phase-3 expansion.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved a new Phase-3 expansion to add specialized Magnet Winding Wires manufacturing capacity, and which is expected to increase the company's total installed capacity to approximately 72,200 metric tons by Q1 of FY 2029.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the majority of Phase-3 expenses to be incurred in FY28 alongside a smaller upfront portion in H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect the majority of these expenses to be incurred in FY '28 though a smaller upfront portion would likely be spent during H2 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 of the Supa expansion is scheduled for completion by March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Number one being, we are on track to complete the remaining phase two capacity by March 2027 with the next wave of addition expected during Q2.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to sustain the trailing 12-month volume growth rate of 26% for the full year FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The higher phase one capacity will be available for the full year FY27 as opposed to only for a part of FY26, and therefore, we feel that we should be able to sustain this rate of volume growth for the full year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
